mapper.sql: legal_entity_id, legal_entity_code, legal_entity_name, unified_social_credit_code, registered_address, legal_representative, contact_phone, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select:
select from sys_legal_entity
and legal_entity_code like concat('%', #{legalEntityCode}, '%')
and legal_entity_name like concat('%', #{legalEntityName}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by status asc, legal_entity_name asc, legal_entity_id asc
select from sys_legal_entity where status = '0' order by legal_entity_name asc, legal_entity_id asc
select from sys_legal_entity where legal_entity_code = #{legalEntityCode} limit 1
select from sys_legal_entity where legal_entity_name = #{legalEntityName} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_legal_entity set legal_entity_code = #{legalEntityCode}, legal_entity_name = #{legalEntityName}, unified_social_credit_code = #{unifiedSocialCreditCode}, registered_address = #{registeredAddress}, legal_representative = #{legalRepresentative}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where legal_entity_id = #{legalEntityId} and version = #{version}
